title: Patch: a greyed Activate or Trade button says why when tapped, as a greyed hand card and a unit already do
thread:
**Issue #3768 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #3768: Patch: a greyed Activate or Trade button says why when tapped, as a greyed hand card and a unit already do
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means
On a phone, tapping the lightning button of a unit whose ability can't be used right now does nothing at all. The reason (already used this turn, not enough mana, nothing to target) appears only in a tooltip on mouse hover, which a touch screen never shows. Tapping a card in hand that can't be played, or a unit that can't attack, already shows a short line saying why. After this, the Activate button and the co-op Trade button do the same, and they still do nothing else.

## Why
- Hand cards and units already answer a refused click with their reason: `apps/web/src/game/actions.ts:878` (the play reason, R979000) and `:1005` (the attack reason, R849000). The board shows it in its reason line (`Game.tsx:761`, `:1001`).
- The Activate control returns before reporting a greyed press (`apps/web/src/game/ActivateControl.tsx:144`, `if (!legal) return;`). Its reason, the view's `ActivationView.reason`, reaches only `title` and `aria-label` (`:137`, `:169-175`).
- Even if the press got through, `startActivation` (`actions.ts:884-898`) returns no notice when no activation of the card is listed.
- R510 (`spec/rulings/R0510.md`) wrote down the tooltip-only behaviour: a greyed control's tooltip gives the reason and it sends nothing.
- Trade (`apps/web/src/game/TradeControl.tsx:69-70`) is `disabled={!live}` with its reason only in `title`. A greyed Trade can't be tapped, focused or read out with its reason.

## Proposal
- A greyed Activate press reaches the board's click handler. `startActivation` returns the view's reason as the notice when no activation of that card and ability is listed. It still sends nothing, and `data-legal` stays false.
- Trade switches from `disabled` to `aria-disabled`, with its reason as its accessible description. A press shows the reason the same way and sends nothing.
- A ruling in the issue's block amends R510 and §10.10's Trade sentence (`spec/10-engine-guide.md:280`), with its §11 paragraph in `spec/pending/<N>.md`.
- It is presentation only: no state, event, replay or AI decision changes (CLAUDE.md rule 7).
- Possible follow-up: an activation-reason line in the inspect sheet's notes (`cards/inspect/StateNotes.tsx`), which today lists only the play and attack reasons.

## Where it lands
- `apps/web/src/game/ActivateControl.tsx`, `apps/web/src/game/actions.ts`, `apps/web/src/game/TradeControl.tsx`, and `apps/web/src/game/Game.tsx` if the notice needs wiring there.
- Their tests: `ActivateControl.test.tsx:158-170` pins today's behaviour and changes to expect the notice as well.
- `spec/rulings/R<N>000.md` and `spec/pending/<N>.md`. SPEC §10.10.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] A Game test with an own unit whose activation is unusable, with a reason: a click on its Activate control shows the reason line with that reason, and no action is sent.
- [ ] `actions.test.ts`: an activate click with no listed activation returns the reason as its notice.
- [ ] A greyed Trade is focusable, its accessible description holds the reason, and a press shows the notice and sends no trade.
- [ ] A live Activate and a live Trade behave exactly as before.
- [ ] The tests are named after the ruling, and `cargo jackioh spec check` and the touched web test files are green.

## Size and risks
- Medium: 8 to 9 files and about 200 lines with tests.
- Making the greyed Trade focusable adds it to the tab order, which is intended.
- The notice keeps the board's existing reason line and its test id.
```
